datasheet.source: Texas Instruments BQ25792 Rev C (SLUSDG1C, August 2022)
datasheet.package: 29-pin VQFN-HR, 4.0 mm nominal body (3.9-4.1 mm), 0.8-1.0 mm body height

symbol.pin_mapping: Table 7-1 roles and logical numbers 1-29; VBUS uses native pin stack [2-3], BAT uses [22-23], GND is pin 27 only. No fictitious pins 30-33 or exposed pad.
symbol.layout: Functional grouping with 2.54 mm side-pin spacing on a taller 40.64 × 30.48 mm body. Left: status/control, I2C, TS/ILIM/PROG/INT; right: switching/bootstrap group above SYS/BAT/BATP/SDRV/ACDRV group; top power pins, GND27 below. CE is marked active-low as ~{CE}; BTST and ACDRV are passive pin types. Preview: ai-files/reports/bq25792-symbol-svg/BQ25792RQMR_unit1.png.

footprint.pitch: 0.4 mm standard signal pitch as named by upstream footprint
footprint.special_geometry: Pads 1, 9, 16 and 24 are official custom-shaped corner lands; exact pad polygons and pad centers retained from installed standard library. These are numbered terminal pads, not additional EP/GND pads.
footprint.manual_drawing_review: TI datasheet rendered at 220 DPI (pages 140-141) and visually compared; package outline and board layout show the RQM HOTROD corner/edge-metal geometry. Candidate footprint geometry replaced with the installed official RQM0029A footprint; prior fabricated regular-perimeter draft is no longer in a library folder.

lead_alignment.orientation: STEP top-view perimeter order matches pad numbers 1 through 29 when STEP +Y is converted to KiCad footprint -Y; first corner lead is pad 1 at STEP (-1.56,+1.68) and the sequence proceeds along left, lower, right and upper edges consistent with the TI/installed footprint numbering.

external_ship_fet.package_mapping: DNH0008A SON-8-EP: gate pad 4; source pads 1–3; drain pads 5–8 plus exposed thermal pad 9 (datasheet top view and recommended land pattern).
external_ship_fet.ratings: 30 V VDS; ±20 V VGS; RDS(on) max 14.2 mΩ at VGS=4.5 V, ID=8 A; Qg 5.3 nC typ / 6.9 nC max at 4.5 V; package-limited continuous current 20 A under datasheet thermal test conditions.
external_ship_fet.ship_topology: Connect source (1–3) to charger BAT and drain (5–9) to physical pack positive. TI Fig. 9-14 depicts a single external N-FET in this orientation; body diode then permits charger-to-pack current and blocks pack-to-charger current with gate off.
external_ship_fet.SDRV_compatibility: BQ25792 Rev C §9.3.12: SDRV typical gate drive is about 5 V above battery with 100 nA typical drive current. CSD17579Q3A needs VGS 4.5 V for its specified RDS(on). Gate charge suggests 53–69 ms idealized charge time at 100 nA; the datasheet does not guarantee this transition estimate across operating conditions. No gate pulldown should be added; confirm timing in the actual application. The 350 ms reset pulse is a related timescale but not proof of guaranteed gate settling.
external_ship_fet.loss_estimate: At 6 A and 14.2 mΩ, room-temperature conduction estimate is 0.51 W. This excludes temperature rise and board thermal resistance; package/datasheet 20 A rating is not blanket board-level 1-second/continuous certification.
external_ship_fet.sourcing_snapshot: LCSC C97376 observed 300 stock, MOQ 5, USD 0.241 each at 5+ during sourcing snapshot; availability and price unverified for purchase date.
external_ship_fet.exact_model: TI DNH0008A.stp downloaded to ai-files/candidates/DNH0008A.stp; FreeCAD decomposition: six solids, four narrow perimeter lands on STEP -X, one wide drain land spanning STEP X/Y with z=0..0.2 mm, and package body z=0.05..0.9 mm. Overall model bbox and footprint suitability still require comparison to TI recommended-land drawing; no FET footprint/model link or registered library asset has been made.
external_ship_fet.symbol: Recognizable native N-MOSFET graphic; Gate pin4, Source native pin stack [1-3], Drain native pin stack [5-9].
external_ship_fet.footprint: Corrected after review against TI Figure 7-2 and 7-3. Nine numbered copper lands: individual source/gate pads 1–4 and drain pads 5–8 plus separately numbered exposed drain pad 9. Pad 9 anchor center is (0.3275,0) with nominal body size 1.775×2.45 mm; main-land left datum −0.56 mm/right edge 1.215 mm and separate drain fingers extend to terminal pads. Side lands are 0.6×0.3 mm, 0.65 mm pitch, with centers x=±1.55 mm and y=±0.975/±0.325 mm. Removed obsolete overlapping terminal paste-only pads. Four paste apertures are 0.705×1.125 mm at x=−0.208/+0.697 mm and y=±0.6625 mm. TI page 9 §7.3 gives the left aperture center 0.208 mm left of the package centerline and 0.905 mm between aperture columns; prior columns were shifted +0.083 mm because they were centered on the offset drain-land anchor. Corrected both candidate footprint and preview-board instance. Footprint instantiated/exported with KiCad 10.0.6; candidate still requires main PCB editor DRC review before activation.
external_ship_fet.step_alignment: TI DNH0008A exact STEP decomposes to four source/gate lead solids on model X<0 and a drain metal solid on X>0, plus molded body. Lead row top-to-bottom mapping after KiCad Y sign flip is 1,2,3,4; high-X drain side matches pad8→5 upper-to-lower. Lead underside Z=0, leads top Z=0.2 mm, body Z=0.05..0.90 mm. Candidate placement origin (0,0,0), scale1, rotation0. These dimensions are consistent with TI Figure7.2 metal/body extent and the footprint origin.
